policy.new_capability_rule: Every new capability must map to an existing claim or introduce a new falsifiable claim before it is treated as research-relevant.
policy.review_policy: Reviewers must check that every claim remains falsifiable, evidence status is bounded by observed evidence, proof references resolve, and schema compatibility is preserved.

claim:accepted-native-readonly-guard.falsifier: The incoming read-only endpoint selection or fixture absence guard is omitted, the guard passes without a fixture, or synthetic proof is represented as real hosted physical enforcement.
claim:accepted-native-readonly-guard.statement: Integrated accepted0.13.1 source retains native physical-read-only route selection and explicit missing-fixture rejection; synthetic SDK checks do not attest live server enforcement.

claim:bounded-snapshot.falsifier: A concurrent write changes the observed snapshot, a mutation succeeds, exhausted results appear complete, cleanup leaves a transaction/callback active, or remote capability invokes an unimplemented operation.
claim:bounded-snapshot.statement: A dedicated read-only SQLite snapshot exposes consistent caller-owned scans with shared native/decoded-result budgets, explicit early stop and cleanup on every exit; unsupported remote routes do not execute or fall back.

claim:logical-cloud-connector.falsifier: Required feature-matrix, native-RPC or cloud connector/auth fixtures fail; credential-bearing data leaks or a request is replayed after loss.
claim:logical-cloud-connector.statement: Local/cloud selection resolves SQLite or native Supabase RPC, and managed-auth requests and user bearers pass through Dactyl with no redirect or automatic replay.

claim:patched-quinn-resolution.falsifier: Resolved SDK graph contains Quinn below0.11.19, HTTP3 activates, required feature or offlineMSRV/package proof fails, or publication is represented as Rust1.75 compatible.
claim:patched-quinn-resolution.statement: The SDK manifest permits only patched quinn-proto in its inactive HTTP graph, without enabling HTTP3; declared and clean-consumer MSRV is Rust1.85.

logical-local-cloud-connector-boundary.statement: LogicalTarget and LogicalConnector resolve local SQLite and cloud public-profile deployments per instance without process-global routing, cross-workspace leakage, or SQLite fallback on failed cloud discovery, across all Cargo feature combinations.
logical-local-cloud-connector-boundary.falsifier: Resolving cloud mutates or depends on ambient DATASTORE* env vars, leaks credentials across independent workspaces, falls back to SQLite when cloud discovery or capability fails, or sends user credentials to public discovery.

managed-session-and-account-readiness-tr.statement: CloudConnector and LogicalConnector transport public discovery, PKCE bootstrap/exchange/refresh/logout, and hosted account/billing readiness routes with redacted diagnostics, complete public error-code allowlist, and explicit outcome_unknown marking on post-send ambiguous mutations.
managed-session-and-account-readiness-tr.falsifier: A credential or private body appears in Debug/Display, a redirect or automatic retry occurs, a Supabase GoTrue error_code or Propodus denial code is dropped, or a lost post-send one-time/mutating response omits outcome_unknown.
